description: Exploratory H1 inner-XQC screen with frozen inherited actor BatchNorm statistics and adaptive alpha. J1/2/4/8, matched return/return and soft/soft critics, N256/G3/B256/delay3/LR5e-5. Requires an auxiliary-enabled checkpoint for return/return; this is not a tuned or confirmatory protocol.

controller.description: Matched critic sources with identical adaptive main actor and inner work budget.

prior.description: Frozen main XQC actor mean; reuse matching completed prior episodes.
